actual_interval: Worker time.perf_counter immediately before and after reader.score_pair(premise,hypothesis). Includes fast tokenizer, CPU tensor construction, model inference, three-way softmax and result construction.
component_latency: context_seconds + reader.latency_seconds + native_query_seconds(if applicable); excludes model/encoder initialization, document partition/embedding setup, common asset verification, process launch and cleanup.
context_seconds: Time to pack source context, verify literal/UTF8/numerical provenance and compute untruncated joint tokens; recorded separately.
correct_short_label: Reader pair latency including tokenization and forward
frozen_scorer_scope_wording_correction: Frozen score_dev.py reports Reader forward wall seconds only; interpret these exact saved p50/p95 as pair latency including tokenization and forward. No stored fields, source files, timing samples or scorer outputs are altered.
native_query_seconds: Native VectorDb search wall time for actual_native arm; controls null.
whole_worker_latency: Execution wall_seconds_including_init_cleanup; retains setup and cleanup bound; not per-question latency.
